If you are referred to the Dunbar FoodShare you will be asked to come to:

Dunbar Parish Church Halls, Abbeylands, High Street, Dunbar. We are next to Reid’s Garage, just before the car park.

We are open to clients on Wednesdays between 12pm and 2.00pm.

Our Social Café is open from 10.30am until 1.45pm.


There you will be welcomed into a friendly, relaxed atmosphere with hot and cold drinks, breakfast rolls, fresh
